newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Nan Ya Feb sales up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Nan Ya Feb sales up 10.8 pct.

text.p: Nan Ya Plastics Corp, Taiwan's largest private industrial firm, said on Thursday its sales rose 10.8 percent in February to T$6.388 billion from T$5.766 billion a year earlier.
But February sales fell 14.8 percent from January's T$7.498 billion, due mainly to the drop in plastics, fibre and electronic material sales, the company said in a statement.
The statement did not provide profit figures.
Combined sales in January and February rose 10 percent to T$13.886 billion from T$12.625 billion a year earlier.
Its full-year 1996 sales fell 2.9 percent to T$88.865 billion from T$91.494 billion in 1995.
Nan Ya said it has set a sales target of T$94.921 billion for 1997, and has attained 14.6 percent of its target.
Nan Ya is a key member of Formosa Plastics group.
